nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a nonempty complete convex subset of a real inner product space $F$, let $P_K$ be the nearest-point projection onto $K$, and let $x \in F$. If $p \in K$ satisfies $\|x - p\| = \inf_{w \in K} \|x - w\|$, then $P_K(x) = p$.
nodes.title: Nearest points coincide with the convex projection

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a nonempty complete convex subset of a real inner product space $F$, and let $P_K$ be the nearest-point projection onto $K$. Then $P_K(x) = x$ for every $x \in K$.
nodes.title: The convex projection fixes the points of the set

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a nonempty complete convex subset of a real inner product space $F$, and let $P_K$ be the nearest-point projection onto $K$. For all $x, y \in F$, $\|P_K(x) - P_K(y)\|^2 + \|(x - P_K(x)) - (y - P_K(y))\|^2 \le \|x - y\|^2$.
nodes.title: Firm nonexpansiveness of the convex projection

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a nonempty complete convex subset of a real inner product space $F$, and let $P_K$ be the nearest-point projection onto $K$. Then $P_K(P_K(x)) = P_K(x)$ for every $x \in F$.
nodes.title: Idempotence of the convex projection

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a nonempty complete convex subset of a real inner product space $F$, and let $P_K$ be the nearest-point projection onto $K$. Then $P_K(x) \in K$ for every $x \in F$.
nodes.title: The convex projection lies in the set

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a nonempty complete convex subset of a real inner product space $F$, and let $P_K$ be the nearest-point projection onto $K$. Then $\|x - P_K(x)\| = \inf_{w \in K} \|x - w\|$ for every $x \in F$.
nodes.title: The convex projection minimizes the distance to the set

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a nonempty complete convex subset of a real inner product space $F$, and let $P_K$ be the nearest-point projection onto $K$. For every $x \in F$, $P_K(x) \in K$ and $\|x - P_K(x)\| = \inf_{w \in K} \|x - w\|$.
nodes.title: Defining property of the convex projection

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a nonempty complete convex subset of a real inner product space $F$, and let $P_K$ be the nearest-point projection onto $K$. For every $x \in F$ and every $w \in K$, $\langle x - P_K(x), w - P_K(x) \rangle \le 0$.
nodes.title: Variational inequality for the convex projection

nodes.summary: For a subset $K$ of a real inner product space $F$ and a point $x \in F$, the nearest-point projection $P_K(x)$ is a chosen point of $F$ such that, whenever $K$ is nonempty, complete and convex, $P_K(x) \in K$ and $\|x - P_K(x)\| = \inf_{w \in K} \|x - w\|$; it is then the unique point of $K$ nearest to $x$. When $K$ fails one of these hypotheses, the value of $P_K(x)$ is unspecified.
nodes.title: Nearest-point projection onto a convex set

nodes.summary: For every subset $K$ of a real inner product space $F$ and every $x \in F$, there is a point $p \in F$ such that, if $K$ is nonempty, complete and convex, then $p \in K$ and $\|x - p\| = \inf_{w \in K} \|x - w\|$.
nodes.title: Totalized existence of the convex projection

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a nonempty complete convex subset of a real inner product space $F$. For every $x \in F$ there is exactly one $p \in K$ with $\|x - p\| = \inf_{w \in K} \|x - w\|$, that is, exactly one point of $K$ nearest to $x$.
nodes.title: Existence and uniqueness of the nearest point

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a nonempty complete convex subset of a real inner product space $F$, and let $P_K$ be the nearest-point projection onto $K$. Then $\|P_K x - P_K y\| \le \|x - y\|$ for all $x, y \in F$, that is, $P_K$ is $1$-Lipschitz.
nodes.title: The convex projection is $1$-Lipschitz

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a convex subset of a real inner product space $F$, let $x, y \in F$, and let $p, q \in K$ satisfy $\|x - p\| = \inf_{w \in K} \|x - w\|$ and $\|y - q\| = \inf_{w \in K} \|y - w\|$, so that $p$ is a point of $K$ nearest to $x$ and $q$ is a point of $K$ nearest to $y$. Then $\|p - q\| \le \|x - y\|$.
nodes.title: Nonexpansiveness of nearest-point selection

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a convex subset of a real inner product space $F$, let $x, y \in F$, and let $p, q \in K$ satisfy $\|x - p\| = \inf_{w \in K} \|x - w\|$ and $\|y - q\| = \inf_{w \in K} \|y - w\|$, so that $p$ is a point of $K$ nearest to $x$ and $q$ is a point of $K$ nearest to $y$. Then $\|p - q\|^2 + \|(x - p) - (y - q)\|^2 \le \|x - y\|^2$.
nodes.title: Firm nonexpansiveness of nearest-point selection

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
